        200:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The optional honorific title of the pet owner (one of MR, MRS,
            MS, DR). When supplied it is prefixed to the last name to form the salutation.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: MR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility; when structured address fields are supplied they take
            precedence and this value is returned as the composed, normalized address
            (normalized addressLine1, with a single space and the normalized
            addressLine2 appended when addressLine2 is present).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address.
            Preferred over the flat address when supplied; an owner is valid when it
            provides either a non-blank addressLine1 or the flat address, plus a city.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal
            address (e.g. unit or apartment). Appended to the composed address when present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it
            must be a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it
            must be valid for the owner's city region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
            QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Optional; when omitted
            on creation it defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The date of birth of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied in
            ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format it drives the derived ageBand.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: Write-only declaration that this owner knowingly shares a household
            (same last name and postcode) with an existing owner. When true it bypasses the
            duplicate-household block, so the owner is created as a declared household member
            rather than rejected as a 409, and is not flagged as a possible duplicate. Absent
            or false means a household collision is rejected.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: Franklin, George
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's salutation, the title followed by a space and the
                last name, or just the last name when no title is given.
              type: string
              example: DR Franklin
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of the owner's first and
                last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: G.F.
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member id
              description: Server-assigned member id formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>', where
                REGION is the region code derived from the postcode, FY the two-digit fiscal year
                of the registrationDate (the fiscal year starts on 1 July), HASH8 the first eight
                upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 digest over the normalized telephone
                followed by the last name, and CHK a single Luhn check digit computed over the
                digits of the preceding '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'.
              type: string
              example: NSW263A7BD3E20
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: Server-assigned stable identifier shared by all owners of the
                same household (same last name and postcode); the first twelve hex characters
                of the SHA-256 digest over the normalized last name and postcode.
              type: string
              example: 3a7bd3e2360a
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: Server-derived key used to detect duplicate owners, formed as
                'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' (email omitted as empty when absent).
                Two owners are duplicates only when their whole identity keys are equal, so
                members of the same household with different telephones are both allowed.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|3a7bd3e2360a3d29eea436fcfb7e44c735d117c42d1c1835420b6b9942dd4f1b'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that shared this owner's first
                and last name (case-insensitively) at the moment it was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners had already been created on this
                owner's registration business day at the moment it was created, otherwise
                false. Flags a potential bulk-signup surge before the hard daily limit.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: True when this owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners
                (inclusive) at the moment it was created, otherwise false. Flags a city
                approaching the hard per-city capacity limit of 50.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when this owner is a suspected soft duplicate of an existing
                owner; otherwise false. A household collision (same last name and postcode) is
                now rejected as a 409 unless the owner declares 'sharesHousehold', and a declared
                household member is not a suspected duplicate, so this stays false for them.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: The ID of the existing owner this owner was flagged a possible
                duplicate of, or absent when possibleDuplicate is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: Derived fiscal year formatted 'FY<YY>', read from the two-digit
                fiscal-year segment of the memberId. YY is the last two digits of the calendar
                year in which the registrationDate's fiscal year begins. The fiscal year starts
                on 1 July, so a registrationDate on or after 1 July is in that year's fiscal year
                and one before 1 July is in the previous year's.
              type: string
              example: FY26
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: Derived membership points. Starts at 0, plus 2 when an email
                is present, plus 1 when the owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0),
                plus 2 for a household of 3 or more, plus 3 for tenure of at least one
                elapsed fiscal year since registration (the fiscal year starts on 1 July).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: Derived membership level from 1 to 4, mapped from
                membershipPoints; 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5 and 4 for 6
                or more. A newly created owner has zero tenure, so a new owner's tenure
                points are out of reach on creation.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: Derived locality (canonical region), the region component of the
                memberId identity (the region derived from the postcode), or 'UNKNOWN'
                when the id carries no region.
              type: string
              example: NSW
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: Derived IANA timezone name for the owner's locality (canonical
                region), from the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the locality
                has no known timezone.
              type: string
              example: Australia/Sydney
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: Derived preferred contact method; 'EMAIL' when the owner has
                an email address, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: EMAIL
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: Derived age band from the owner's birthDate as at the
                registrationDate; 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, and
                'SENIOR' from 65. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: ADULT
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: Derived market segment '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when
                membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the
                locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: STANDARD_METRO
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans as the country
                calling code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g.
                '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: Whether the owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is
                false; DELETE /api/owners/{id} flags it true while retaining the record, so the
                owner is still returned on later reads and is ignored by the create endpoint's
                duplicate and identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical API path of this owner, '/api/owners/' followed
                by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: /api/owners/1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
